summary: Lincoln NF site at 9,270 ft: 1926 Aermotor LX cab on a 35-ft tower, now gone; a US Air Force telemetry antenna occupies the ground, with only a benchmark left.

facts.design: Aermotor LX-25 type cab on a 35-foot tower (the register calls it LX-24)
facts.status_note: The tower is gone. A US Air Force telemetry antenna occupies the site, and only a benchmark remains
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Lincoln National Forest

access.note: The Forest Service page is labeled 'Site Open', but a US Air Force telemetry antenna occupies the site and no source describes public access to that facility today. The register says the site was accessible in 2015, when a telemetry station already occupied it

events.note: Alamogordo and Albuquerque papers report a new 35-foot all-steel tower replacing the old wooden tower; the register and Forest Service date the lookout to 1926
Aermotor LX cab on a 35-foot tower; the register says built in 1926 as an LX-24, and the Forest Service says erected in 1926 as an LX-25
May 1933 Alamogordo News item: Alex Quick and family moved out to the tower to maintain a lookout for forest fires
By the 2015 register entry the site was occupied by a Holloman AFB telemetry station; the tower's removal date is not in these sources
Registered August 30, 2015 as US 1604, NM 3; nominated by Mark Gutzman

corrections.why: A US Air Force telemetry antenna occupies the site and no source describes public access to that facility. The Forest Service page's 'Site Open' label is the only sign of public access.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Service calls the cab an Aermotor LX-25; the register calls the same lookout an LX-24. The sources do not say which model is right.
The record's RIDB listing reads standing. The Forest Service page, last updated February 19, 2025, says only a benchmark remains, so the gone status holds. The RIDB listing itself was not read.
The 1925 papers describe a new steel tower replacing an old wooden one, while the register and Forest Service date the LX cab to 1926. The sources do not reconcile the two dates.

notes_for_editor: Record says gone, public access, and RIDB standing. The Forest Service page (updated February 19, 2025) and the register both say the tower is gone, so status stays gone; the RIDB listing was not read. Access corrected to restricted because a US Air Force telemetry antenna occupies the site; the FS 'Site Open' label conflicts, so check before anyone visits. The build date is disputed: 1925 papers describe a new steel tower, while the register and FS say 1926. Model is LX-25 (FS) vs LX-24 (register). The record's 10.7 m matches the 35-foot tower height; the sources give tower height, not cab-floor height, so height_m was left out of facts. The West Lookouts page ends with a bare 'Removed' label and no date, so no removed event was added. No photos added.
